feature: Study home and local adaptive spaced repetition
checks: Course resumes the saved chapter and sentence
Explicit chapter completion preserves the position and enrolls understanding questions
Finished chapters remain available during a paused video project
Four memory ratings adapt intervals and a lapse shortens the next review
Review does not overwrite normal learning position
Idempotent network retry and stale tab conflict
Existing due dates retained without invented memory ratings
Missing or archived targets omitted from the queue without deletion
Unscored recordings do not create a memory rating
Japanese calendar midnight and 105 due items counted beyond a 100-item queue batch
Mobile 390px home has no horizontal overflow
LAN HTTPS home and review API return 200
Live browser answer is hidden before reveal and all four rating choices become available
limits: Retention target uses default FSRS weights and is not a measurement of the learner's biological forgetting curve
Memory ratings are learner self reports; pronunciation evaluation is independent
